index.title: Tibia Calculators
index.subtitle: 14 free tools for planning training, valuing your character and analysing results.

trueSkill.title: True Skill ★
trueSkill.description: Reverse the loyalty bonus. Compare skills as shown in game with highscores.
trueSkill.infoBody: This calculator is the bridge between calculators and Bazaar. Bazaar shows skills WITHOUT loyalty bonus, the game shows them WITH the bonus.

displayedSkill.label: Skill shown in game
displayedSkill.help: Value from the character status (with loyalty bonus).

recommendations.bazaar: Base skill: {value}. Bazaar will show {value} (without the {discount} bonus).

stamina.title: Stamina
stamina.description: Regeneration time, premium vs free efficiency.

currentStamina.label: Current stamina
currentStamina.help: Value from the character window (in hours).

targetStamina.label: Target stamina
targetStamina.help: Max value for this account: {max} h

isPremium.label: Account status
isPremium.help: Premium = up to 42 h + green zone (Happy Hours). Free = up to 40 h, no green zone.

recommendations.premiumNormal: Premium: {rate} min offline = 1 min stamina in normal zone (0-39 h).
recommendations.free: Free: {rate} min offline = 1 min stamina (no green zone).
recommendations.withGreen: Premium: {normalRate} min/h in normal zone, {greenRate} min/h in green zone 39-42 h.
recommendations.full: Stamina already full ({value} h). Nothing to regenerate.

errors.invalidTarget: Maximum for this account is {max} h

experience.title: Experience / Levelling
experience.description: Time needed to advance from current to target level at a given XP/h rate.

targetLevel.label: Target level
targetLevel.help: Level you want to reach (must be > current).

recommendations.alreadyThere: You're already at the target level — nothing to gain.
recommendations.underDay: Less than a day — quick level-up.
recommendations.underWeek: Less than a week — standard level-up.
recommendations.longTerm: Long-term grind — consider changing pace or target.

errors.invalidRate: XP/h rate must be an integer > 0

expShare.title: Exp Share
expShare.description: XP split in a party using Tibia's formula (equal share + vocation diversity bonus).

labels.totalXpHelp: Total XP amount to distribute among party members.
labels.partyMembersHelp: Add up to 4 members (besides yourself). Tibia allows max 5 people in a party.

table.name: Name
table.soloNote: No party — all XP goes to you.

errors.invalidTotalXp: Enter XP as a non-negative integer (max 10¹²)
errors.illegalPartyRange: Party level difference exceeds Tibia legal range (ratio > 1.5).
errors.duplicateNames: Party member names must be unique.

leech.title: Leech
leech.description: Leech percent from a party accounting for level differences (CipSoft + community reduction).

labels.reductionPerLevelHelp: Community convention: how much % share drops per level of difference (default 0.05 = 5%).
labels.partyMembersHelp: Add up to 4 higher-level characters you leech XP from.

recommendations.solo: No party — solo, all XP for you.
recommendations.illegal: Level difference exceeds Tibia legal range — leech = 0%.
recommendations.equal: Tibia equal split (50/50) — full leech with no reduction.
recommendations.ok: Leech share in normal range — worth hunting in this configuration.
recommendations.low: Low leech share — consider changing the party configuration.

exerciseWeapons.title: Exercise Weapons
exerciseWeapons.description: Calculate how many exercise weapons you need for a target skill (or skill from N weapons). Includes loyalty bonus, double event, private dummy and TC price threshold.

category.label: Vocation / skill pair
category.help: One of 8 pairs from architecture §2.1 — pick the contextual pair for your character.

currentSkill.label: Current skill
currentSkill.help: Base skill (without loyalty bonus) — what Bazaar reports.

percentToNext.label: % to next level
percentToNext.help: Tibia shows %, not points. Enter 0 for a freshly gained level.

targetSkill.label: Target skill
targetSkill.help: The skill level you want to reach.

numWeapons.label: Number of weapons
numWeapons.help: How many exercise weapons you intend to use.

loyaltyPct.label: Loyalty bonus (%)
loyaltyPct.help: Tibia: +5% per 360 loyalty points. Higher bonus = fewer weapons needed.

doubleEvent.label: Double event
doubleEvent.help: During a double event you need 2× fewer weapons for the same effect.

privateDummy.label: Private dummy
privateDummy.help: Demon / Ferumbras / Monk dummy: 10% faster training.

tcPriceThreshold.label: TC price threshold (gp)
tcPriceThreshold.help: TibiaWiki: if 1 TC costs more than 13,889 gp, buy for gold. Default: 13,889.

recommendations.buyGold: Buy for gold — TC price ({tcPrice} gp) exceeds the {threshold} gp threshold.
recommendations.buyTc: Buy with TC — TC price ({tcPrice} gp) is below the {threshold} gp threshold.
recommendations.equal: Both methods cost the same (TC = {tcPrice} gp ≈ {threshold} gp threshold).

errors.invalidTarget: Target skill must be higher than current
errors.invalidNum: Number of weapons must be an integer ≥ 0
errors.invalidLoyalty: Loyalty bonus must be one of 0, 5, 10, …, 50
errors.invalidThreshold: TC price threshold must be a positive number

skills.title: Training / Skills
skills.description: Time and cost to train from current to target skill on any weapon — with a precision warning for non-Regular weapon types.

category.label: Vocation / skill pair
category.help: One of 8 pairs from architecture §2.1 — the contextual skill for your character.

targetSkill.label: Target skill
targetSkill.help: The skill level you want to reach.

percentToNext.label: % to next level
percentToNext.help: Tibia shows %, not points. 0 for a freshly gained level.

weaponType.label: Weapon type
weaponType.help: Only 'Regular' gives a precise time. Other types are approximate (assume full weapon usage).

offline.label: Offline training
offline.help: Offline training consumes stamina — but the time stays the same.

warnings.approximate: Only 'Regular' weapons give a precise time/cost. Other types assume full weapon usage — they may overestimate the result.

recommendations.approximate: TibiaWiki: only 'Regular' weapons give a precise time. The chosen type assumes full weapon usage.
recommendations.precise: 'Regular' weapon — result matches the TibiaWiki Skills Calculator.

errors.invalidTarget: Target skill must be higher than current

imbuement.title: Imbuement Cost
imbuement.description: Imbuement slot costs (basic/intricate/powerful) — TC + gp, per TibiaWiki.

imbuementType.label: Imbuement tier
imbuementType.help: Basic = cheapest slot (25 TC), Intricate = mid tier (no extra TC), Powerful = top tier (150 TC).

level.label: Character level
level.help: Informational — used to assess game context.

recommendations.basic: Basic: {slot} TC slot + {fee} gp fee — cheapest tier.
recommendations.intricate: Intricate: {fee} gp fee (uses Basic slot, no extra TC).
recommendations.powerful: Powerful: {slot} TC slot + {fee} gp fee — top tier, full power.

errors.invalidType: Pick a tier from the list
errors.invalidLevel: Enter level as a non-negative integer
errors.invalidHours: Enter duration as a non-negative integer

blessings.title: Blessing Cost
blessings.description: Blessing cost per TibiaWiki R(L) — XP-loss protection at your level.

currentBlessings.label: Current blessings
currentBlessings.help: How many of the 7 blessings you already have (0 = none, 7 = full XP-loss protection).

recommendations.alreadyFull: You already have 7/7 — full XP-loss protection.
recommendations.fullProtection: Full protection 7/7 — {count} × cost per blessing from R(L).
recommendations.partial: Buy {count} blessings to boost your XP-loss protection.

errors.alreadyHigher: You already have a higher level — enter a higher targetLevel.

weeklyTasks.title: Weekly Tasks
weeklyTasks.description: Maximum XP per weekly task by level and difficulty.

difficulty.label: Difficulty
difficulty.help: Beginner (from 1), Adept (from 30), Expert (from 150), Master (from 400). XP cap grows with difficulty.

taskType.label: Task type
taskType.help: Kill and delivery use the same XP formula (TibiaWiki BR).

recommendations.noCap: Base XP {base} below cap {cap} — difficulty {difficulty} does not limit the reward.
recommendations.capped: Base XP {base} exceeds cap {cap}. You will get {xp} XP (capped). Consider a higher difficulty.
recommendations.levelTooLow: Difficulty {difficulty} requires level >= {required}. Your character has {current} — pick a lower difficulty or level up.
recommendations.masterUnlimited: Master has no cap — you receive the full base XP.

charms.title: Charms Damage
charms.description: Damage percent from charms per vocation/skill — TibiaPal benchmark.

skill.label: Attack skill
skill.help: Your main attack skill (marginal synergy with charm).

charm.label: Charm
charm.help: Major charm (elemental: 5% of monster HP) or Overpower/Overflux (self-scaling).

monsterType.label: Monster sensitivity
monsterType.help: weak (×1.2) / neutral (×1.0) / resistant (×0.5) / immune (×0). Does not apply to Overpower/Overflux.

recommendations.weakAgainst: Monster weak against the element → damage above baseline.
recommendations.resistant: Monster resistant to the element → consider a different charm.
recommendations.immune: Monster immune to this element — Overpower/Overflux still work.
recommendations.knightOverpower: Knight + Overpower → +30% damage vs Sorcerer (HP scaling).
recommendations.mageOverflux: Sorcerer/Druid + Overflux → +30% damage vs Knight (MP scaling).

plannersCharms.title: Charm Planner
plannersCharms.description: Plan your charm point allocation (max {maxPoints}) for optimal damage and leech — with per-vocation recommendations.

vocation.label: Vocation
vocation.help: Your character class (drives top-3 charm recommendations).

maxPoints.label: Charm points cap
maxPoints.help: Maximum total pool of charm points to allocate (default {default}, from T16 `charm.max_points`).

recommendations.noRecommendations: No recommendations for this vocation - pick another.
recommendations.overCap: Over cap! {over} points above the limit.
recommendations.ready: Build ready to share - copy link or export.
recommendations.empty: Allocate at least one point to see suggestions.

plannersWheel.title: Wheel of Destiny Planner
plannersWheel.description: Plan your Wheel of Destiny point allocation (max {maxPoints}) for your vocation — with 5 curated presets and Markdown export.

vocation.label: Vocation
vocation.help: Your character class (changes preset and recommended proportions).

level.label: Character level
level.help: Your current level (drives available Wheel budget — max ~1000 at 200+).

preset.label: Curated preset
preset.help: Pick one of 5 curated builds (TibiaPal Wheel Builds) or start from a blank allocation.

offensive.label: Offensive
offensive.help: Points in Wheel offensive nodes (damage / crit). 0-{max} pts.

defensive.label: Defensive
defensive.help: Points in Wheel defensive nodes (HP / shielding). 0-{max} pts.

support.label: Support
support.help: Points in Wheel support nodes (healing / leech / utility). 0-{max} pts.

presetsDesc.knightTankDesc: Maximum survivability: heavy defensive + leech. For team play and PvE solo on bosses.
presetsDesc.paladinBalancedDesc: Even split across offensive / defensive / support. The most universal build for exp hunts.
presetsDesc.druidSupportDesc: Maximum support (heal party, buffs). Druid as healer/ex-buffer.
presetsDesc.sorcererDamageDesc: Maximum damage (AoE spells). Exp hunt on weak monsters.
presetsDesc.monkHybridDesc: Balanced melee + fist with leech. Good for solo hunt and PvP.

recommendations.offensiveHint: Knights and Sorcerers prioritise offensive. Monks balance with defensive.
recommendations.defensiveHint: Knights prioritise defensive. Sorcerers invest the minimum here.
recommendations.supportHint: Druids and Paladins dominate support. Knights invest the minimum here.
recommendations.valid: Build is within budget - ready to share.
recommendations.empty: Allocate at least 1 pt in one category to see the summary.

errors.invalidLevel: Level must be an integer in [8, 2500]

premium.tooltip: Full breakdown with per-component weights — for Premium accounts (coming soon).

characterValue.title: Character Value ★
characterValue.description: Estimate your character's value in Tibia Coins. ★ Killer feature — transparent algorithm with full breakdown.

vocation.label: Vocation (base)
vocation.help: 5 base classes: Knight, Paladin, Druid, Sorcerer, Monk.

world.label: World (optional)
world.help: World name (e.g. Jadebra). Optional for private characters.

skills.help: Base skill (without loyalty bonus). Only above 100 and only relevant skills for vocation count.

charmPoints.label: Charm points
charmPoints.help: Sum of charm points (≥ 7000 gets weight bonus).

goldTotal.label: Gold (bank + inventory + depot)
goldTotal.help: Total character gold. Converted to TC at 13 900 gp = 1 TC.

tcInvested.label: TC invested (optional)
tcInvested.help: Tibia Coins spent on this character. Visible in UI only for Premium.

blessingsActive.label: Active blessings (0–7)
blessingsActive.help: 5 = Spirits of Five; 7 = full protection + Twist of Fate.

marketBid.label: Current market bid (TC)
marketBid.help: If you enter a bid, you will see the opportunity indicator (delta % vs our valuation).

result.breakdownDescription: Each component with its weight — algorithm transparency builds trust.

breakdown.features: Features (Soul War, Primal Ordeal, World Transfer, blessings, ...)
breakdown.progression: Progression (charms, boss points, quests, imbuements, animus, achievements)

recommendations.okWithBid: Estimated value: {value} TC. Your market bid: {bid} TC.
recommendations.underpriced: Market price ({bid} TC) is below valuation ({value} TC) — opportunity ({delta}%).
recommendations.overpriced: Market price ({bid} TC) is above valuation ({value} TC) — overpaying ({delta}%).
recommendations.fairPrice: Market price is close to valuation ({delta}%) — fair price.
recommendations.confidenceLow: Confidence is low — fill in more character data (items, TC invested).
recommendations.confidenceHigh: Confidence is high — full auction detail.
